headline: Philippine Inflation Hits 44-Month High of 7.8% Amid Rising Fuel Costs
summary: Philippine inflation reached a 44-month high of 7.8% in October, driven by soaring petrol prices linked to the Middle East conflict. The country continues to face economic pressure from a devalued peso.
why: Inflation data is a primary indicator for central bank policy, influencing interest rate decisions and currency valuation in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: High inflation and currency devaluation typically pressure economic growth and central bank policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: High inflation readings often force central banks to raise interest rates, which can impact equity markets and currency stability.
